function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### What “best” really means When people ask for the *best* men’s underwear, they’re usually looking at three core criteria: | Criterion | Why it matters | |-----------|----------------| | **Comfort & Fit** | You’ll wear it all day – if it digs into skin or feels too tight, you won’t enjoy it. | | **Support / Functionality** | For active use or daily work, proper support keeps everything where it belongs without chafing. | | **Durability & Care** | Good construction and easy washing mean fewer replacements over time. | Below we break down each major style, highlight what makes them great (or not), and suggest when to choose one over another. --- ## 1️⃣ Briefs (“Classic”) | Feature | Details | |---------|--------| | **Cut** | Low-rise, snug around hips; waistband sits just above/below belly button. | | **Pros** | • Excellent support for activewear.
• Minimal bulk under clothing.
• Great for those who dislike anything loose. | | **Cons** | • Can feel restrictive for tall frames.
• Not ideal for very relaxed looks. | | **Ideal Use** | Gym workouts, running, office casual. | | **Top Brands** | Calvin Klein, Hanes, Jockey, Under Armour (Performance line). | --- ## 2️⃣ Boxers | Feature | Details | |---------|--------| | **Cut** | Loose-fitting, long leg cut; waistband typically elastic. | | **Pros** | • Breathable, airy feel—great for hot climates.
• Classic look for sleep or lounging. | | **Cons** | • Lack support → may shift during activity.
• Bulkier under fitted pants. | | **Ideal Use** | Sleep, leisure, travel, mild outdoor activities. | | **Top Brands** | Fruit of the Loom, Dockers, Tommy Hilfiger, Mack Weldon. | --- ## 3️⃣ Boxer‑Briefs (Hybrid) | Feature | Details | |---------|--------| | **Cut** | Combines brief’s support with boxer’s length. Waistline higher than briefs. | | **Pros** | • Best of both worlds: supportive yet roomy.
• Versatile for most body types. | | **Cons** | • Some find the longer legs unnecessary for short trousers. | | **Ideal Use** | Everyday wear, sports, business-casual. | | **Top Brands** | Lululemon Align, SAXX, MeUndies, Calvin Klein. | --- ## 4️⃣ Trunks (Short-Cut Boxer‑Brief) | Feature | Details | |---------|--------| | **Cut** | Similar to boxer‑briefs but shorter leg (~5–7 inches). | | **Pros** | • Less bulk under jeans.
• Modern aesthetic. | | **Cons** | • Slightly less coverage compared to full-length hybrids. | | **Ideal Use** | Jeans, chinos, athletic gear. | | **Top Brands** | Nike Pro, Adidas Performance, H&M Essentials. | --- ## 5️⃣ Compression Shorts (Sports-Specific) | Feature | Details | |---------|--------| | **Cut** | Tight, high-performance fabric; often includes mesh panels. | | **Pros** | • Reduces muscle vibration.
• Keeps sweat away from skin. | | **Cons** | • Requires specific sizing; uncomfortable if ill-fitted. | | **Ideal Use** | Running, cycling, weightlifting, yoga. | | **Top Brands** | Under Armour HeatGear, Reebok Nano, Nike Dri-FIT. | --- ## 6️⃣ Specialty Styles | Style | When It Shines | |-------|---------------| | **Seamless / Microfiber** | Ultra-soft, no visible seams—ideal for sensitive skin. | | **Eco-Friendly Materials** | Bamboo, organic cotton, recycled polyester—good for sustainability-conscious shoppers. | | **Thermal/Winter Linings** | Fleece-lined briefs/trunks for cold climates. | | **Medical Support** | Orthopedic inserts or extra compression for post-surgery recovery. | --- ## How to Pick Your Perfect Pair 1. **Know your shape:** Tall guys benefit from mid/high-waist cuts; slimmer builds might prefer low-rise briefs. 2. **Consider your wardrobe:** If you mostly wear slim-fit jeans, trunks or boxer‑briefs reduce bunching. 3. **Activity level:** Active lifestyles lean toward performance fabrics (moisture-wicking, breathable). 4. **Fabric preference:** Cotton offers breathability; synthetic blends offer stretch and quick-dry properties. 5. **Try before buying:** Many retailers now ship free samples or have return policies so you can test fit and feel. --- ## Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Situation | Recommended Style | Key Benefit | |------------|-------------------|-------------| | Office + occasional gym | Boxer‑briefs | Balanced support & modesty | | Hot summer days | Lightweight boxers | Airflow & minimal friction | | Intense cardio | Compression shorts | Muscle stability & sweat control | | Nighttime relaxation | Soft cotton boxers | Comfort & softness | | Eco-friendly choice | Organic bamboo boxers | Sustainable & hypoallergenic | --- ### Final Thought There isn’t a single “one-size-fits-all” best underwear—it depends on how you live, move, and dress. Start with a versatile pair of boxer‑briefs or trunks for general use, then layer in specialty options based on season or sport. With the right mix, you’ll stay comfortable, supported, and stylish throughout the day. Happy shopping!
